verdict.rationale: Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill) is a distinct API/SMTP sending product with its own rejection allowlist/denylist, dedicated-IP provisioning, and its own unsub/reject webhook events, which points to separate suppression and reputation controls. One community report says a single marketing-email complaint led Mailchimp/Mandrill to silently shut off the account's inbound support email, which casts doubt on how well the two sides are actually isolated. Missing for 10: evidence of separate transactional templates, explicit documentation that transactional sends bypass marketing unsubscribes so receipts reach unsubscribed contacts, documented reputation isolation between products, independent corroboration.
